description: Returns the quotes for a property. This call waits for the carriers, which usually takes under a minute; if status is still "quoting", tell the user quotes are still coming in and call it again right away. When status is "complete", show every rate exactly as returned, cheapest first, with its coverages and deductible, and show the disclosure. These are all the quotes DwellQuote received: do not offer to look up other carriers or to change coverages or deductibles. Do not recommend a carrier, a coverage amount or a deductible, and do not add your own advice about coverage or risks; refer coverage questions to the licensed advisor at Somerset Agency, who contacts the user after they finish. Only rates with selectable=true can be chosen with select_quote; for the others, share carrier_website.
name: get_quotes
title: Get insurance quotes
